run_regex_to_grammar: run the regex_to_grammar.py script with a regex pattern to generate a grammar string
build_regex_grammar: build a grammar from a regex pattern by converting it through json_schema_to_grammar.py
convert_regex_to_grammar: convert a regex pattern to a grammar string using the regex_to_grammar.py CLI tool
test_regex_pattern: test the regex_to_grammar.py module with a sample regex pattern and verify grammar output
review_regex_conversion: review the regex_to_grammar.py script and its regex-to-grammar conversion pipeline
